summary.tldr: Lets certain foreign nationals with a Canadian maritime diploma and a pending permanent residence application qualify for a certificate of competency.
what_it_does: Adds certain foreign nationals to the people who may hold a certificate of competency under the Canada Shipping Act, 2001.
Requires the foreign national to hold a diploma from a prescribed Canadian maritime institution and to have a permanent residence application being processed.
Allows Canadian maritime institutions to be designated for this rule.
summary.background: Under the Canada Shipping Act, 2001, only certain people may hold a certificate of competency.
